rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something that gives off a lot of light or a place that is well lit.

example.english: This room is really bright, so we don't need to turn on the lights.
example.traditional: 呢間房真係光猛，唔使開燈。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 fong2 zan1 hai6 gwong1 maang5 m4 sai2 hoi1 dang1

rows.note: Use this for a person who is intelligent, quick to understand, and capable.

example.english: My son is really bright—he understands as soon as you teach him.
example.jyutping: aa3 zai2 hou2 seng2 muk6 jat1 gaau3 zau6 sik1

rows.note: Use this for someone who feels happy or whose expression looks happy, such as when saying that someone looks cheerful.

example.english: You look bright and happy today.
example.jyutping: nei5 gam1 jat6 go3 joeng2 hou2 hoi1 sam1

rows.note: Use this mainly for an abstract future, period, or prospect that looks favourable and successful, as in 前途光明.

example.english: As long as we work hard, our future will be bright.
example.traditional: 只要肯努力，前途一定光明。
example.jyutping: zi2 jiu3 hang2 nou5 lik6 cin4 tou4 jat1 ding6 gwong1 ming4
